The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

translations.web: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
translations.bsb: The rock badger, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
translations.kjv: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean
translations.asv: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
